crossRefs.note: Many there are who say of my soul, “There is no help for him in God.”
You sons of men, how long shall my glory be turned into dishonor? Will you love vanity and seek after falsehood?
All those who see me mock me. They insult me with their lips. They shake their heads, saying,
“He trusts in Yahweh. Let him deliver him. Let him rescue him, since he delights in him.”
As with a sword in my bones, my adversaries reproach me, while they continually ask me, “Where is your God?”

translations.web: You frustrate the plan of the poor, because Yahweh is his refuge.
translations.bsb: You sinners frustrate the plans of the oppressed, yet the LORD is their shelter.
translations.kjv: Ye have shamed the counsel of the poor, because the LORD is his refuge.
translations.asv: Ye put to shame the counsel of the poor, Because Jehovah is his refuge.
